statements.full_source_line: Glavan-Miao-Prokopec-Woodard's 2026 result is exactly the precedent your dispatch cites: for a **scalar probe** (\(\Psi\) playing both source and observer), the one-graviton-loop self-mass is gauge-*dependent* under a Δα gauge variation until diagram classes 6, 7, and the external-mode-function correction \(\delta u = \delta u_I+\delta u_{II}\) are added — none of which existed in the pre-2026 literature ([2602.07908](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07908) §4, §8; Table 2's six-column cancellation, eq. 8.1). Their own words: *"unlike in flat space, additional diagrams and contributions are necessary, including the one-loop corrections to the external mode functions... In curved space, secular corrections to mode functions are possible; they combine with one-loop corrections to the amputated four-point function to yield a gauge-independent result."* That sentence is the load-bearing one: it says secular content **can be physical** post-assembly in de Sitter — assembly does not generically kill logs, it can also legitimate them. It also says the authors themselves do not yet know whether *their own* scalar-probe logs survive: *"Only once this is done will we have a definitive answer as to whether the large quantum-gravitational logarithms persist."*

statements.full_source_line: "tier_note": "BANKED 2026-06-27 (consolidated overseer relay, Brief 1 Outcome 3a -- ANCHOR confirmed, NOT refuted): single-pole is ANCHOR-class, derived-pending -- an independent referee found the minimal inputs do NOT determine the transport class (do NOT over-demote this anti-GRUT result past what was shown). TWO-LEVEL FRONTIER (named missing input = the TRANSPORT SELF-ENERGY Sigma controlling G_R = 1/(G0^-1 - Sigma)): (1) committing the system/bath partition yields only the FREE bath correlator (super-Ohmic, collisionless-AT-FREE-LEVEL) which by itself does NOT decide the fork; (2) Sigma additionally needs the bath's INTERNAL dynamics (graviton-graviton scattering / nonlinear mode coupling / Boltzmann) -> read the low-omega scaling CLASS: Ohmic (Im G_R ~ eta*omega) -> single-pole holds; non-Ohmic / Weinberg free-streaming power-law-tail kernel -> single-pole fails. The decision is a one-bit low-omega scaling CLASS read off a FULL transport self-energy calc -- NOT 'one number from one vertex', and NOT the |omega|/sub-Ohmic s<1 shorthand (a RETIRED mischaracterization; the failure mode is the Weinberg branch cut). Do NOT read free-level super-Ohmicity as the Weinberg free-streaming failure branch -- the decision lives entirely in Sigma from the bath's INTERNAL dynamics. So single-pole is pending a MODELING COMMITMENT GRUT has not made, NOT a referee computation; this low-omega scaling class is FRONTIER-RESERVED (specify and hand out, do NOT approximate Sigma in-house). REFEREE REBUTTALS banked as corroboration (no tier/ledger change): KMS != viscosity; de Sitter / Gibbons-Hawking != a colliding gas; Weinberg branch cut = an extra collisionless ASSUMPTION (the collisionless branch, tidied to the Weinberg reading). Bank the PROOF, not the specialist's favorable prior ('the vacuum probably has finite transport coefficients' = ZERO evidential weight; 'finite eta' is strictly weaker than 'single Debye pole'). Collisionality is the ANCHOR's open input #17, decided only by the full transport calc. [Pre-screen history:] GENUINELY OPEN (both leans live), 2026-06-26 -- tier derived-pending with a FAVORABLE-BUT-CIRCULAR lean (see reconciliation at end). [History:] finite-T CONFIRMED 2026-06-25 by open-systems specialist via ANALYTICITY: the coth 1/omega is exactly cancelled by one of the three powers of omega in J~omega^3, so S(omega)=a*omega^2+b*omega^4+... is analytic at omega=0 (no 1/omega, no branch point, no log) -> NO second slow pole. The s:3->2 softening is structural, not numerical; memory stays cutoff-set (tau_c~1/omega_c). Single-pole holds at finite T. Graduated derived-pending -> DERIVED. RE-QUALIFIED 2026-06-26: tier stays 'derived' but REGIME-CONDITIONAL -- the result is real within the COLLISIONAL/ANALYTIC-bath regime; a NEW specialist raised that a COLLISIONLESS free-streaming (Weinberg) bath gives a branch cut that dissolves the single pole (see boundary_condition, second boundary). NOT folded as settled in either direction (three specialists conflict); the deciding question -- is GRUT's bath collisional or free-streaming-collisionless -- is open and traces to the unpinned system/bath split (ledger #2). 'derived, specialist-confirmed' must no longer stand UNQUALIFIED. ISOLATED-BATH VERDICT 2026-06-26 (specialist, FAVORABLE lean -- partial reprieve, NOT settled): the object is rho_chi(omega)=2 Im chi^R_TT(omega) for the vacuum BEFORE the conformalon. Two IR universality classes -- Class A (local vacuum fluctuations: Caldeira-Leggett/DOS/KMS/local Schwinger-Keldysh -> rho~omega^3 analytic, single-pole survives, exponentially-localized memory) vs Class B (free-streaming ballistic transport, Weinberg 2004 -> rho~|omega| or omega^2 ln omega, branch cut, single-pole dissolves, infinite directional memory). LEAN: Class A (rho~omega^3), single-pole SURVIVES -- because GRUT's OWN stated axioms (Gaussian, KMS-locked, linear-response, finite-memory, local influence functional) ARE the analytic class, and nothing in the present formulation introduces a collisionless kinetic sector at the bath level. CAVEAT: 'strong inference, NOT a theorem' -- specialist explicitly declines to settle it. NEAR-CIRCULARITY (mark, do not absorb): GRUT's finite-memory PREMISE essentially IS the Class-A choice, so single-pole 'following' is partly definitional; the genuinely independent earned content is the finite-T analyticity robustness check (within Class A, finite-T could have generated a slow second pole and does not). THE REAL OPEN QUESTION (sharpened by the specialist): NOT the exponent but 'what is the bath HILBERT SPACE integrated out to produce the GRUT influence functional?' -- needs a FIRST-PRINCIPLES derivation of rho_chi from the microscopic DOF, not argument-by-analogy to either oscillator baths or collisionless transport. Tier STAYS derived-pending (favorable lean, not settled). Net ledger unchanged (+10); collisionality input #17 refined to 'GRUT's vacuum is Class A (the bath Hilbert space is Gaussian KMS fluctuations, not free-streaming carriers)'. TRANSPORT/VISCOSITY PIN 2026-06-26 (REVERSES the above lean, lands AGAINST single-pole, demotes derived-pending -> ASSUMED): the previous chain (and the original DOS argument) committed a CATEGORY ERROR -- the super-Ohmic omega^3/omega^4 object is the T=0 VACUUM RESPONSE (graviton-emission phase space, high-freq probe), NOT the thermal MEMORY kernel. The right variable is NOT an exponent but tau_collision: single-pole memory time = the collision time, single-pole <=> tau_collision << tau_0. KEY FACT (rock-solid kinetic theory, not a delicate loop): a FREE field has INFINITE shear viscosity (nothing relaxes momentum, eta ~ tau_collision -> inf); the transport peak narrows to a delta(omega) of diverging weight (non-decaying shear mode) = the non-analytic structure, tau_K -> inf. The MINIMAL de Sitter vacuum is FREE fields -> tau_collision = inf -> FREE-STREAMING -> single-pole DISSOLVES (NOT super-Ohmic omega^3). de Sitter adds T_dS=H/2pi but NO collisions unless put in by hand; the only escape is super-horizon FREEZING (omega<H modes don't free-stream, may suppress the delta(omega) weight) -- but that is (a) UNCOMPUTED and (b) even maximally gives tau_K ~ 1/H ~ 14 Gyr ~ 300x tau_0 (~42 Myr) = the SLOW regime, STILL not single-pole. So single-pole requires GRUT to POSIT collisions with tau_collision << tau_0 -- a NEW microphysical input the minimal vacuum does NOT supply. Hence ASSUMED (+1), not derived. RIGOROUS COMPUTATION (the de-anchor, for the Part-1 specialist, in isolation before the conformalon): Im<T_TT T_TT>(omega->0,k->0) for a free field on de Sitter in Bunch-Davies/Gibbons-Hawking, into the super-horizon limit, with free-streaming-vs-freezing as the explicit object. RECONCILED 2026-06-26 (proposer of the transport pin UPDATES -- this is the settled state): the viscosity argument is FLAT-SPACE finite-T kinetic and does NOT cleanly transfer to de Sitter -- Gibbons-Hawking is observer-dependent (not a real particle gas), the Bunch-Davies vacuum stress correlator is ANALYTIC by microcausality, and super-horizon FREEZING can suppress exactly the streaming piece the argument leans on. So Class B is NOT established on dS and Class A (analytic) has real merit there. STATE: GENUINELY OPEN, both leans live (NOT 'leans against', NOT split-the-difference). Tier reverts ASSUMED -> DERIVED-PENDING; ledger +1 -> 0; net +11 -> +10. SHARPENED CIRCULARITY (tighter than 'axioms favor A'): Gaussian/KMS/linear-response do NOT force Class A -- a Gaussian KMS bath can free-stream (Weinberg's neutrinos ARE essentially that). The axiom that forces Class A is LOCALITY/FINITE-MEMORY of the influence functional == single-pole RESTATED. So the favorable lean and the assumption are the SAME object -> the lean carries ALMOST NO independent evidential weight; do NOT bank it as reassurance. The ONLY genuinely-independent earned content is the small finite-T robustness check (within the assumed analytic class, coth could have manufactured a slow second pole and does not -- real, small, the right size). CONVERGENCE = the actual signal: specialist (lean A) + proposer (lean B) + the document (ledger #2 system/bath split) all land on the BATH HILBERT SPACE -- three paths, one question, robust BECAUSE it survives the disagreement about which way single-pole goes.",

statements.full_source_line: "boundary_condition": "CONDITIONAL (logged as a known boundary, not absorbed): the confirmation holds for the standard QBM construction with a smooth UV cutoff + bilinear coupling, PROVIDED GRUT's vacuum bath carries NO second internal dynamical scale (resonance/diffusive mode). A second scale would give a genuine second pole tau_2 (nu(t)~A e^{-t/tau_c}+B e^{-t/tau_2}). See rung7: an evolving w(z) REQUIRES exactly such a second (cosmologically slow) scale -- the two facts are coupled. SECOND BOUNDARY (2026-06-26, NEW specialist, NOT folded as settled): single-pole holds for a COLLISIONAL / analytic-noise bath. For a genuinely COLLISIONLESS free-streaming bath (Weinberg 2004 nonlocal memory) the kernel is power-law (K(t)~1/t^alpha, Bessel tails) -> Sigma(omega) has a BRANCH CUT at omega->0 (~|omega| or omega^2 log omega), NOT a pole -> the single pole DISSOLVES into a continuum (no dynamical mass, power-law not exponential relaxation). THREE specialists now CONFLICT on single-pole: (1) DOS [3+1D free relativistic modes super-Ohmic, J~omega^3 analytic -> holds], (2) analyticity [finite-T coth cancellation -> holds], (3) Weinberg [collisionless free-streaming -> branch cut -> FAILS]. Likely reconciliation = two senses of 'collisionless': the DOS/SPECTRUM of vacuum fluctuations (single-pole survives) vs FREE-STREAMING TRANSPORT of anisotropic stress (branch cut). Which GRUT's bath instantiates is decided by the UNPINNED system/bath split (ledger #2). So single-pole is DERIVED WITHIN THE COLLISIONAL/ANALYTIC REGIME; whether GRUT's vacuum is in that regime is OPEN -- the next question, to specialist 1 (does the DOS/analytic single-pole survive a Weinberg free-streaming bath, or does it introduce a branch cut the analysis omitted?). SPINE TEST RUN 2026-07-04 (loaded onto the Tan-Tsamis-Woodard COMPUTED object, arXiv:2103.08547 -- an EXTRACTION of the low-omega transport class from a known pure-graviton dS self-energy, NOT a from-scratch loop; four grapples both-directions vs the firewall guards; DEFAULT-BROKEN). VERDICT: UNDER-DETERMINED -- but EARNED, replacing the previously-guessed 'probably under-determined' (predicting the outcome was exactly the move the discipline forbids). The probe does NOT graduate rung3 (STAYS derived-pending, ledger 0): the low-omega TT class lives in the gauge/scheme/prescription-dependent part of the object -- the 30-year dS-IR controversy in local form (the gauge-artifact, scheme-flip, and null-collision guards all fire). It banked THREE grounded things the guess did not have. (1) TT-FROZEN [leading-order, simplest-gauge; does NOT clear the gauge guard]: the perturbative TT sector does NOT itself provide evidence for the branch-cut (Class-B) interpretation -- TTW state explicitly 'there are no changes in the graviton mode function' at one loop, and the secular ln(a) is in the SPIN-0 potentials Psi, Phi, NOT the TT channel that G_R^TT probes. This DEFUSES the REFUTED reading FOR THE TT CHANNEL, and is NOT evidence for single-pole: a frozen mode function is EQUALLY consistent with a trivial / no-response -- the Higuchi/Marolf-Morrison stability horn. So 'frozen' sits BETWEEN single-pole and trivial and distinguishes NEITHER (absence-of-evidence-against, not evidence-for). CRISP FORM [external specialist wording, adopted verbatim 2026-07-04, cleaner than the in-house phrasing]: 'The existing perturbative TT calculations remove one commonly cited argument for an inevitable branch-cut interpretation, but they do not positively establish a relaxation pole.' (2) HORN-CONDITIONAL [a DERIVED fork, not a shrug]: the under-determination decomposes along the dS-IR controversy -- Tsamis-Woodard IR-SCREENING horn: secular resums to a dynamical graviton mass => pole => Class A => HOLDS; Higuchi / Marolf-Morrison IR-STABILITY horn: the growth is a gauge artifact removed by the assembled observable => trivially analytic / ambiguous; the un-resummed object AS LITERALLY COMPUTED: the secular ln(a) is a REAL feature but does NOT establish a transport branch cut -- secular growth in the TIME-domain response is NOT rho(omega) ~ |omega| at omega->0 (the two are separated by exactly the omega->0 ANALYTIC CONTINUATION that has NOT been done), so even the un-resummed object does NOT force Class B. 3RD CORRECTION [external specialist 2026-07-04, the MIRROR of the referee's HOLDS-side catch]: our earlier 'secular => cut => REFUTED-leaning' over-identified a secular logarithm with a transport branch cut -- the SAME class of over-claim, on the OPPOSITE horn. Conceding it makes the under-determination SYMMETRIC: TT-frozen removes a branch-cut argument WITHOUT establishing a pole; the secular log is real but establishes NO cut; NEITHER pole NOR cut is forced by the current calculations. (The collisional/Class-A route is separately UN-established: graviton-graviton scattering in dS is suppressed as Gamma ~ G^2 H^5 (dimensional/order-of-magnitude estimate, NOT a computed rate; the forced cubic-GR vertex carries dimensionless coupling GH^2 ~ (H/M_Pl)^2, so Gamma/H ~ (H/M_Pl)^4) -- extraordinary IR suppression -- so collision-induced hydrodynamics is NOT demonstrated either.) NET (the grounded form of 'everything gates on rung3'): GRUT's single-pole spine is NATURALLY SUPPORTED IF de Sitter IR-SCREENS -- FORWARD DIRECTION ONLY (IR-screening -> dynamical mass -> pole). The CONVERSE (single-pole -> screening) is UNPROVEN: other pole-generating mechanisms (a different resummation, a genuine collisional channel) are NOT excluded, so this is NOT a biconditional until a uniqueness theorem closes the converse. statements.full_source_line: "tier_note": "POSED 2026-07-02 (Version II, the referee's Frontier 3, adjudicated-in). THE CATCH (conceded): the earlier map said TWO frontiers; there are THREE -- deriving coarse-graining does NOT hand you a constitutive/response structure (that follows only under extra conditions: weak coupling, Gaussianity, near-equilibrium, timescale separation). So three genuinely distinct layers, previously two were collapsed: why-split (U3 / F2, the setup) -> why-constitutive (U4 / F3, the form) -> which-kernel (rung3 / F1, the content). U4 is NOT covered by U1: U1 says 'GIVEN the constitutive conditions, the form is universal-and-standard (Feynman-Vernon)'; U4 asks 'why do those conditions hold at all / why is constitutive structure generic' -- strictly deeper. This is now V2's CENTRAL question (the constitutive-universality question: why do constitutive descriptions appear in every successful EFT?); U1/U2 demote to GRUT-specific INSTANCES of it. It reframes GRUT from a candidate-to-validate into a PROBE of the universality/microscopic boundary -- the boundary where thermodynamics vs statistical mechanics, hydrodynamics vs molecular dynamics, EFT vs UV-completion all live. DISCIPLINE: fenced BOTH directions (do not pre-answer emergent OR forced); do NOT collapse F2 (U3) and F3 (U4); and 'we found a third frontier' is a truer MAP, NOT a third MOVE -- F3 is arguably the LEAST tractable, so forward-gating is unchanged (external: rung3 specialist / dS-IR / foundational-EFT progress). THREE COUPLED FACETS (2026-07-04): U4 is ONE frontier worked in a FIXED ORDER of three coupled facets -- assumption-space (III) -> theorem (VIII) -> interpretation (II); interpretation (II) CANNOT precede the theorem (VIII). One frontier, structured -- fix the assumption-space, prove the theorem, THEN interpret; never interpretation-first. BRANCHES (2026-07-04): U4 is operationalized as a CLASSIFICATION tree under the u0 charter -- u5_constitutive_phases (universality classes of chi) and u6_constitutive_order (order parameter of constitutive organization), each with first-class success AND failure conditions, pointing toward an observable EFT. CENTRAL OBJECT: u4 derives / interrogates the EXISTENCE of 'constitutive organization' (GLOSSARY.md, provisional/revisable per u0) -- the equivalence class of response functionals chi(omega,k) producing identical observable transport under admissible coarse-grainings. See GRUT_II_Agenda.md. statements.full_source_line: "boundary_condition": "OPENING SURVEY RESULT 2026-07-04 (the u5 analog of the rung3 candidate-methods pass -- an admissibility FILTER over universality CLASSES, one level up from the harness's kernel filter; ungated -- this is ADMISSIBILITY, not the rung3-gated PLACEMENT; firewalled both-directions before banking, amber->green). CONSTRAINTS applied to the dissipative/dynamical universality zoo: KMS/detailed-balance, causality/Kramers-Kronig, passivity (Im chi >= 0), influence-functional structure, and Lorentz/diffeo-invariance + T_mu_nu-conservation (no preferred frame). BANKED RESULT = a TWO-SECTOR EXCLUSION (one-sided, clean): (a) KMS/detailed-balance EXCLUDES the entire FAR-FROM-EQUILIBRIUM / DRIVEN-DISSIPATIVE Keldysh sector (Sieberer-Buchhold-Diehl 2016; KPZ-polariton, dark-state driven criticality) -- clean BY CONSTRUCTION, since those classes are DEFINED by the ABSENCE of detailed balance, so a passive KMS vacuum cannot be one (the driven character is robust: the d=1+1 KPZ accidental Edwards-Wilkinson/FDT symmetry is a stationary-measure coincidence with a nonzero stationary current, NOT KMS detailed balance, so the exclusion stands). (b) Lorentz/diffeo + T_mu_nu-conservation + no-preferred-frame EXCLUDES the LITERAL Hohenberg-Halperin Models A-J (1977) -- meaning the NON-relativistic MODEL EQUATIONS themselves (frame-fixed Langevin dynamics, Einstein relation set by one rest-frame T, frame-dependent kinetic coefficients), which a vacuum with no preferred frame cannot instantiate. LOAD-BEARING PRECISION (do NOT drop 'literal'): this excludes the frame-fixed EQUATIONS, NOT the universality CLASSES -- the fixed-point scaling content SURVIVES relativistic covariantization (relativistic Model B for a conserved charge, relativistic Model H near the QCD critical point are standard, actively-studied constructions). WHAT SURVIVES: the RELATIVISTIC, passive, KMS-equilibrium, causal viscoelastic-TRANSPORT sector -- whose candidate internal classes are the relativistic-covariant analogs of the momentum/charge-conserving, reversible-mode-coupling subset (A-D are purely relaxational; E/F/G/H/J carry the reversible Poisson-bracket streaming term, Model H -- conserved OP advected by conserved transverse momentum -- being the T_mu_nu/stress-tensor analog). That subset is FAVORED because a conserved stress tensor forces reversible advective OP couplings; but the relativistic analogs of E/F/G/H/J are ADMISSIBILITY CANDIDATES whose count is NOT yet resolved (<= these, pending the u6 count), and relaxational relativistic classes (rel. Model A/B) are NOT asserted to be excluded -- they are simply not the stress-tensor transport class. HARD FENCE (both directions -- the both-directions pass CANCELLED a 'rigid/unique' over-reach against a 'phase-structure' over-reach): bank EXCLUSION ONLY. Exclusion is NOT uniqueness -- excising the OUTSIDE (driven, non-relativistic) does NOT show the surviving sector is a SINGLE class; and it is NOT phase structure -- the count is not shown to be >1 either. THE COUNT inside the surviving sector -- one class (responsiveness RIGID / forced) vs a family (constitutive PHASE STRUCTURE) -- IS OPEN and is LOAD-BEARING ON u6: the order parameter is a REQUIRED missing label (together with the conserved-charge content and coupling structure) needed to enumerate/count the classes, so u5 and u6 are COUPLED at the frontier and u6 is the named next step that lets u5 finish the count. CONSISTENCY CHECK (a reassurance, NOT a result): GRUT's own constitutive ontology -- rung1 (S_IF) + rung2 (KMS) + rung4 (Love/KK viscoelastic) -- sits INSIDE the admissible surviving sector; it did NOT pick an excluded class. HONEST PROVENANCE: the builder LED this turn predicting 'rigid/unique' (the strong horn); the both-directions pass cancelled it to 'exclusion only' before it reached the register. u5 STAYS to-derive, ledger 0; net +12 unchanged at banking (2026-07-04). See GRUT_II_Agenda.md. RE-HOMED QUESTION 2026-08-02 (from the p_tt interrogation, verdict CHOSEN -- see p_tt_ansatz.boundary_condition): 'IS zeta_vacuum = 0?' is a constitutive-classification question and now lives HERE. The interrogation hands V2 the {shear, bulk} TWO-MODULI family as the admissible kernel space (P^(2) + P^(0,s) after diffeo-Ward); the INTERIOR (zeta_vacuum != 0, not the excluded trace-only endpoint) is empirically viable and UNEXPLORED -- exactly the sector where the observables live. Adds a GRUT-specific instance to u5's classification; tier/ledger unchanged. DEFORMABILITY CALC 2026-07-04 (calc/u5u6_deformability.py + calc/RESULTS_u5u6_deformability.md, in-house TOY/SCALING, default-BROKEN, graduates NEITHER u5 nor u6; firewalled both-directions, amber->green) -- the COUNT this claim owes now has its scaling-level structure: the shared deformability computation FACTORS the deformability question into two knobs (fixing the scaling-level STRUCTURE of u5's count and u6's order-parameter-reality together; graduating neither). KNOB 1 (RG-relevance / sharp-vs-deformable): UNDECIDED at scaling level -- z=1 is a FIXED-POINT ASSUMPTION (a thermal/KMS medium breaks boosts, so NOT a symmetry theorem), and under z=1 the non-relativistic Hohenberg-Halperin upper-critical-dimension logic does NOT transfer; the fixed-point anomalous dimension is the decider (a loop / epsilon-expansion research calc). The toy fixes only that the Model-H bracket (OP advected by conserved momentum T^{0i}) is SYMMETRY-FORCED-PRESENT (T_mu_nu-conservation + Lorentz) -- NECESSARY, NOT sufficient, for a sharp H-class (presence != relevance). KNOB 2 (conserved-charge content): DECIDABLE -- a bracket {phi,Q} exists only if Q is conserved; T_mu_nu is universal (H always available, flat-space EFT sense), every OTHER bracket needs an EXTRA charge (J a non-abelian internal charge, E/F a U(1), G internal+staggered). GIVEN sharp, the u5 count is a MONOTONE function of charge content (~1 per unlocked bracket; some classes need combined structure and one charge can seed several). THE REDUCTION: the deformability question reduces to 'how many conserved charges beyond T_mu_nu does the vacuum carry?'. Settled TOGETHER at scaling level: sharp+extra-charges => u6 order parameter REAL + u5 PHASE STRUCTURE; DEFORMABLE => u6 COLLAPSES + u5 RIGID (info_i2-adjacent); sharp+only-T_mu_nu => u6 real-but-SINGLE-VALUED + u5 RIGID (count 1); (pure gravity gives count 1 in BOTH horns). FENCES: TOY/SCALING (NOT the fixed-point RG -- points the direction, horn stays UNDECIDED); the conserved-charge content is a FENCED MODELING INPUT (rung3-channel-shaped -- a conformalon/anomaly current beyond T_mu_nu is NOT settled here), a SECOND rung3-shaped input DISTINCT from u6's already-held coarse-graining/slow-variable conditional (the independent-definition guard's conditional pass), which stays LIVE and un-discharged; both horns FIRST-CLASS; 'only T_mu_nu => rigid' is a LEAN conditioned on TWO inputs (the charge content AND 'sharp'), NOT a result. u5/u6 STAY to-derive, ledger 0; net +12 unchanged. statements.full_source_line: "tier_note": "BANKED 2026-06-27 (consolidated overseer relay, Brief 1 Outcome 3a -- ANCHOR confirmed, NOT refuted): single-pole is ANCHOR-class, derived-pending -- an independent referee found the minimal inputs do NOT determine the transport class (do NOT over-demote this anti-GRUT result past what was shown). TWO-LEVEL FRONTIER (named missing input = the TRANSPORT SELF-ENERGY Sigma controlling G_R = 1/(G0^-1 - Sigma)): (1) committing the system/bath partition yields only the FREE bath correlator (super-Ohmic, collisionless-AT-FREE-LEVEL) which by itself does NOT decide the fork; (2) Sigma additionally needs the bath's INTERNAL dynamics (graviton-graviton scattering / nonlinear mode coupling / Boltzmann) -> read the low-omega scaling CLASS: Ohmic (Im G_R ~ eta*omega) -> single-pole holds; non-Ohmic / Weinberg free-streaming power-law-tail kernel -> single-pole fails. The decision is a one-bit low-omega scaling CLASS read off a FULL transport self-energy calc -- NOT 'one number from one vertex', and NOT the |omega|/sub-Ohmic s<1 shorthand (a RETIRED mischaracterization; the failure mode is the Weinberg branch cut). Do NOT read free-level super-Ohmicity as the Weinberg free-streaming failure branch -- the decision lives entirely in Sigma from the bath's INTERNAL dynamics. So single-pole is pending a MODELING COMMITMENT GRUT has not made, NOT a referee computation; this low-omega scaling class is FRONTIER-RESERVED (specify and hand out, do NOT approximate Sigma in-house). REFEREE REBUTTALS banked as corroboration (no tier/ledger change): KMS != viscosity; de Sitter / Gibbons-Hawking != a colliding gas; Weinberg branch cut = an extra collisionless ASSUMPTION (the collisionless branch, tidied to the Weinberg reading). Bank the PROOF, not the specialist's favorable prior ('the vacuum probably has finite transport coefficients' = ZERO evidential weight; 'finite eta' is strictly weaker than 'single Debye pole'). Collisionality is the ANCHOR's open input #17, decided only by the full transport calc. [Pre-screen history:] GENUINELY OPEN (both leans live), 2026-06-26 -- tier derived-pending with a FAVORABLE-BUT-CIRCULAR lean (see reconciliation at end). [History:] finite-T CONFIRMED 2026-06-25 by open-systems specialist via ANALYTICITY: the coth 1/omega is exactly cancelled by one of the three powers of omega in J~omega^3, so S(omega)=a*omega^2+b*omega^4+... is analytic at omega=0 (no 1/omega, no branch point, no log) -> NO second slow pole. The s:3->2 softening is structural, not numerical; memory stays cutoff-set (tau_c~1/omega_c). Single-pole holds at finite T. Graduated derived-pending -> DERIVED. RE-QUALIFIED 2026-06-26: tier stays 'derived' but REGIME-CONDITIONAL -- the result is real within the COLLISIONAL/ANALYTIC-bath regime; a NEW specialist raised that a COLLISIONLESS free-streaming (Weinberg) bath gives a branch cut that dissolves the single pole (see boundary_condition, second boundary). NOT folded as settled in either direction (three specialists conflict); the deciding question -- is GRUT's bath collisional or free-streaming-collisionless -- is open and traces to the unpinned system/bath split (ledger #2). 'derived, specialist-confirmed' must no longer stand UNQUALIFIED. ISOLATED-BATH VERDICT 2026-06-26 (specialist, FAVORABLE lean -- partial reprieve, NOT settled): the object is rho_chi(omega)=2 Im chi^R_TT(omega) for the vacuum BEFORE the conformalon. Two IR universality classes -- Class A (local vacuum fluctuations: Caldeira-Leggett/DOS/KMS/local Schwinger-Keldysh -> rho~omega^3 analytic, single-pole survives, exponentially-localized memory) vs Class B (free-streaming ballistic transport, Weinberg 2004 -> rho~|omega| or omega^2 ln omega, branch cut, single-pole dissolves, infinite directional memory). LEAN: Class A (rho~omega^3), single-pole SURVIVES -- because GRUT's OWN stated axioms (Gaussian, KMS-locked, linear-response, finite-memory, local influence functional) ARE the analytic class, and nothing in the present formulation introduces a collisionless kinetic sector at the bath level. CAVEAT: 'strong inference, NOT a theorem' -- specialist explicitly declines to settle it. NEAR-CIRCULARITY (mark, do not absorb): GRUT's finite-memory PREMISE essentially IS the Class-A choice, so single-pole 'following' is partly definitional; the genuinely independent earned content is the finite-T analyticity robustness check (within Class A, finite-T could have generated a slow second pole and does not). THE REAL OPEN QUESTION (sharpened by the specialist): NOT the exponent but 'what is the bath HILBERT SPACE integrated out to produce the GRUT influence functional?' -- needs a FIRST-PRINCIPLES derivation of rho_chi from the microscopic DOF, not argument-by-analogy to either oscillator baths or collisionless transport. Tier STAYS derived-pending (favorable lean, not settled). Net ledger unchanged (+10); collisionality input #17 refined to 'GRUT's vacuum is Class A (the bath Hilbert space is Gaussian KMS fluctuations, not free-streaming carriers)'. TRANSPORT/VISCOSITY PIN 2026-06-26 (REVERSES the above lean, lands AGAINST single-pole, demotes derived-pending -> ASSUMED): the previous chain (and the original DOS argument) committed a CATEGORY ERROR -- the super-Ohmic omega^3/omega^4 object is the T=0 VACUUM RESPONSE (graviton-emission phase space, high-freq probe), NOT the thermal MEMORY kernel. The right variable is NOT an exponent but tau_collision: single-pole memory time = the collision time, single-pole <=> tau_collision << tau_0. KEY FACT (rock-solid kinetic theory, not a delicate loop): a FREE field has INFINITE shear viscosity (nothing relaxes momentum, eta ~ tau_collision -> inf); the transport peak narrows to a delta(omega) of diverging weight (non-decaying shear mode) = the non-analytic structure, tau_K -> inf. The MINIMAL de Sitter vacuum is FREE fields -> tau_collision = inf -> FREE-STREAMING -> single-pole DISSOLVES (NOT super-Ohmic omega^3). de Sitter adds T_dS=H/2pi but NO collisions unless put in by hand; the only escape is super-horizon FREEZING (omega<H modes don't free-stream, may suppress the delta(omega) weight) -- but that is (a) UNCOMPUTED and (b) even maximally gives tau_K ~ 1/H ~ 14 Gyr ~ 300x tau_0 (~42 Myr) [MARKER 2026-08-18, not a correction: '~42 Myr' is the PRIOR LINEAGE's figure, appearing here only comparatively, inside the argument RETRACTED the same day by its own proposer (see the RECONCILED entry). It is not banked, and no node's content depends on a value of the memory scale -- confirmed by the 2026-08-18 sweep of all 18 nodes touching it, which found only limits, class questions, and the separately-priced second scale. Retained because the retracted reasoning is retained; marked so a reader grepping the clean register for a memory-scale value cannot misread it as banked.] = the SLOW regime, STILL not single-pole. So single-pole requires GRUT to POSIT collisions with tau_collision << tau_0 -- a NEW microphysical input the minimal vacuum does NOT supply. Hence ASSUMED (+1), not derived. RIGOROUS COMPUTATION (the de-anchor, for the Part-1 specialist, in isolation before the conformalon): Im<T_TT T_TT>(omega->0,k->0) for a free field on de Sitter in Bunch-Davies/Gibbons-Hawking, into the super-horizon limit, with free-streaming-vs-freezing as the explicit object. RECONCILED 2026-06-26 (proposer of the transport pin UPDATES -- this is the settled state): the viscosity argument is FLAT-SPACE finite-T kinetic and does NOT cleanly transfer to de Sitter -- Gibbons-Hawking is observer-dependent (not a real particle gas), the Bunch-Davies vacuum stress correlator is ANALYTIC by microcausality, and super-horizon FREEZING can suppress exactly the streaming piece the argument leans on. So Class B is NOT established on dS and Class A (analytic) has real merit there. STATE: GENUINELY OPEN, both leans live (NOT 'leans against', NOT split-the-difference). Tier reverts ASSUMED -> DERIVED-PENDING; ledger +1 -> 0; net +11 -> +10. SHARPENED CIRCULARITY (tighter than 'axioms favor A'): Gaussian/KMS/linear-response do NOT force Class A -- a Gaussian KMS bath can free-stream (Weinberg's neutrinos ARE essentially that). The axiom that forces Class A is LOCALITY/FINITE-MEMORY of the influence functional == single-pole RESTATED. So the favorable lean and the assumption are the SAME object -> the lean carries ALMOST NO independent evidential weight; do NOT bank it as reassurance. The ONLY genuinely-independent earned content is the small finite-T robustness check (within the assumed analytic class, coth could have manufactured a slow second pole and does not -- real, small, the right size). CONVERGENCE = the actual signal: specialist (lean A) + proposer (lean B) + the document (ledger #2 system/bath split) all land on the BATH HILBERT SPACE -- three paths, one question, robust BECAUSE it survives the disagreement about which way single-pole goes. *** ADVERSE EVIDENCE RECORDED RETROSPECTIVELY, 2026-08-19 (owner ruling: evidence moved and nothing fired, so it is recorded in the node's own text rather than by superseding a pre-registration; NO TIER OR LEDGER MOVE). calc/finite_T_pole_structure.py answers the question calc/finite_T_exponent.py left open on 2026-06-25 -- 'does the s_eff=2 spectrum carry a slow second pole that the cutoff-set memory time hides?' It is not a second pole. coth(omega/2T) has a simple pole at omega = 2 pi i n T for EVERY n, residue 2T; this is a property of the KMS factor alone and is independent of J and of the regulator. With T = H/2pi -- fixed uniquely here at rung2 and paid at rung5, explicitly not a free input -- the NOISE kernel carries a MATSUBARA LADDER at omega = -i n H, spacing exactly H. Weighting by residue (J ~ omega^3 gives n^3), the leading rung's share is (1-x)^4/(1+4x+x^2) with x = e^{-Ht}: 6.1% at Ht = 1, reaching 90% only at Ht = 4.32. rung7 carries tau_2 ~ 1/H0, i.e. Ht ~ 1, so THE COSMOLOGICAL SECTOR OPERATES ABOUT FOUR E-FOLDS SHORT OF WHERE SINGLE-POLE BECOMES A GOOD APPROXIMATION, and no limit of the parameters moves it there because H is the only scale the framework has. Robust to the regulator: truncating at n <= 3 lifts the Ht = 1 share only to 13.2%. AND IT IS DENSER THAN THE STRUCTURE IT REPLACED -- the static-patch QNM tower retracted the same day had spacing 2H; this ladder has spacing H, and the second rung is ~294% of the first at Ht = 1 once residues are included. 'The tower was retracted' reads as a reprieve and is the opposite. THE ONE STEP NOT TAKEN, which is this node's actual claim: the ladder is in the NOISE kernel of the bilinear QBM split; the retarded kernel is T-independent and untouched. Whether the Mori-Zwanzig memory kernel of the projected dynamics INHERITS the ladder is not established. It is sharply posed rather than open-ended: KMS ties N to Im K_R, so N inherits coth's poles UNLESS Im K_R has zeros at the Matsubara frequencies that cancel them, and that cancellation is the only route by which the projected kernel could fail to inherit the ladder. *** *** THE ADVERSE FILING ABOVE IS NARROWED, 2026-08-19, BY THE PARTY IT DISFAVOURS. calc/mz_inheritance.py takes the inheritance step. TWO RESULTS, opposite in direction. (1) THE ESCAPE ROUTE IS CLOSED: the framework's own J has no zeros on the imaginary axis (J(i v) = eta (i v)^3 exp(+v^2/w_c^2), nonzero for every v and every s tested), so nothing cancels coth's poles and the SYMMETRISED noise kernel does inherit the ladder exactly as framed. (2) BUT THE SYMMETRISED CORRELATION IS NOT THE ONLY CANDIDATE, AND THE OTHER STANDARD ONE HAS NO LADDER. Mori-Zwanzig projection for a quantum system conventionally uses the KUBO-MORI (canonical) inner product, and the Kubo correlation carries C_K(w) = 2 chi''(w)/(beta w) rather than C_S(w) = chi''(w) coth(beta w/2) -- derived here from the Kubo transform's definition, not quoted. The coth is REPLACED by 2/(beta w): every Matsubara pole is gone, leaving one pole at w = 0. Separately, the generalised-Langevin FRICTION kernel contains no temperature at all (verified bit-identical at two temperatures) while the noise kernel's late-time rate tracks 2 pi T to 0.07-0.09%. SO: the phrase 'the Mori-Zwanzig kernel' in this node's own statement DOES NOT DENOTE A UNIQUE OBJECT, and the two objects it could denote answer the inheritance question OPPOSITELY. The adverse reading is therefore CONDITIONAL on identifying it with the symmetrised correlation, which this node does not do. This is a defect in the node's STATEMENT, not in its physics; it is cheap to repair and must be repaired before the ladder can be said to bear on the conjecture. Until then the ladder neither refutes nor spares single-pole, and the honest disposition is that the node is UNDER-SPECIFIED exactly where the evidence would bite. *** *** AND A SCOPE CORRECTION TO THE STATIC-PATCH WORK, same date, also against the adverse direction (owner): A POLE-FREE FREE RESPONSE IS NULL, NOT ADVERSE. Pure de Sitter has no scattering centre; the graviton potential is purely centrifugal, l(l+1)/sinh^2(H r_*), and that exactly-solvable case is FORCED to return a finite Blaschke amplitude. A trivial scattering problem returns a trivial answer, so the free level carries no evidence either way -- and with c = 0 now DERIVED (calc/static_patch_tt_response.py PART 1b), the 'artefact of an exactly-solvable potential' caveat is the operative fact rather than a hedge. Everything that bears on this node rests on the interacting self-energy Sigma. *** *** AND THE NARROWING IS ITSELF NARROWED, 2026-08-19, BACK TOWARD ADVERSE -- because reading THIS NODE'S OWN PRE-EXISTING TEXT answers the convention question it was said to leave open. This node has carried since 2026-06-25: 'finite-T CONFIRMED ... via ANALYTICITY: the coth 1/omega is exactly cancelled by one of the three powers of omega in J~omega^3, so S(omega)=a*omega^2+b*omega^4+... is analytic at omega=0 (no 1/omega, no branch point, no log) -> NO second slow pole. ... memory stays cutoff-set (tau_c~1/omega_c). Single-pole holds at finite T.' TWO CONSEQUENCES. (i) THE CONVENTION IS NOT UNSTATED AFTER ALL: that check is performed on S = J coth, the SYMMETRISED noise spectrum, so this node's own finite-T history identifies its kernel and the adverse reading of the Matsubara ladder APPLIES rather than being conditional. The narrowing recorded above was too generous to this node and is withdrawn to that extent. (ii) THE BANKED CLAIM'S NEGATIVE HALF DOES NOT FOLLOW FROM ITS ARGUMENT. The positive half is correct and is re-verified in calc/mz_inheritance.py PART 3b: with J ~ omega^3 the 1/omega really is cancelled and S is analytic at the origin. But 'analytic at omega = 0' is a statement about ONE POINT, and coth's poles sit at omega = 2 pi i n/beta for every n != 0, where J does not vanish -- residue J(2 pi i n/beta)*(2/beta), verified nonzero at n = 1,2,3,7. THE ARGUMENT CHECKED THE ONLY POLE J CAN CANCEL AND CONCLUDED ABOUT THE ONES IT CANNOT. Correspondingly 'memory stays cutoff-set' is false: the ladder's slowest component sits at 1/(2 pi T) = 1/H, which for this framework is enormously slower than any UV cutoff time. TWO INSTRUMENTS, TWO DIFFERENT MISSES, ONE BANKED CONCLUSION: the analyticity check looked at the single point where cancellation was possible, and the tau_nu memory-time diagnostic is a |nu|-weighted mean in which the ladder carries almost none of the weight (calc/finite_T_pole_structure.py PART 4). 'Single-pole holds at finite T' rests on both. NO TIER OR LEDGER MOVE is taken here; this is the same retrospective recording the owner ruled for, and what it changes is that the ladder's adverse bearing is now unconditional rather than convention-dependent. *** *** MULTIPOLE CORRECTION AND A TWO-SIDED RESULT, 2026-08-19, calc/mz_inheritance.py PART 1b. THE CORRECTION IS FILED FIRST BECAUSE THE FAVOURABLE HALF IS THE QUOTABLE ONE. The graviton has NO l = 0 and NO l = 1, so every physical multipole has l >= 2; an earlier pass tabulated l = 1, which is not a graviton mode. The free static-patch spectral function A_l vanishes at the first l Matsubara rungs, so THE SLOWEST SURVIVING RUNG IS (l+1)H. CONSEQUENCE, AGAINST THE ENTRIES ABOVE: the free-level memory time is 1/(3H), NOT 1/H, and every statement in this register reading 'slowest rung exactly H' or 'memory time 1/H' -- including the Matsubara-ladder filing earlier this same day -- is about a ladder containing modes the graviton does not have. AND IT IS MULTIPOLE-DEPENDENT: 3H at l=2, 4H at l=3, (l+1)H generally. THIS NODE ASSERTS *THE* MEMORY TIME; THE FREE THEORY SUPPLIES A FAMILY INDEXED BY MULTIPOLE. That is a stronger objection than any share arithmetic: single-pole is not a poorly-dominated approximation here, the single rate it approximates DOES NOT EXIST at free level. THE FAVOURABLE HALF, real and booked as such: because every physical l >= 2, RUNGS n = 1 AND n = 2 VANISH FOR EVERY PHYSICAL MULTIPOLE -- the geometry genuinely kills the two slowest rungs, the ones governing late-time memory. That is the first structural result in this fortnight running toward the framework. It does not rescue single-pole: the leading surviving rung carries 6.4% at l=2 and Ht=1 (2.5% at l=3, 1.0% at l=4 -- the share FALLS with l), and the escape still requires Sigma to manufacture zeros at n > l where the free theory has none, l-dependently, to yield any single rate at all. STATUS: numerically verified, NOT adversarially tested, and it runs the direction the builder already expected -- the profile of both errors this week. Not to carry a dispatch until a hostile pass has had it. NO TIER OR LEDGER MOVE. *** *** ADVERSARIAL PASS, 2026-08-19: all four lenses returned NOT-REFUTED -- the adverse conclusion stands -- and all four found the STATEMENT wrong. calc/mz_inheritance.py PART 1c. (1) THE ZERO SET WAS UNDER-COUNTED, FAVOURABLY: N carries an overall factor of omega, so it vanishes at omega = 0 and at the negative rungs too -- exactly 2l+1 zeros, |n| <= l -- so l+1 NON-NEGATIVE rungs cancel, not l. (2) 'A IS PROPORTIONAL TO N' IS FALSE AS WRITTEN, reported independently by two lenses: A = N psi_reg(x_<) psi_reg(x_>)/(2iW), and that prefactor is entire of order 1 with INFINITELY MANY zeros (for l=2 at x=0.9 near omega = 6.256, 10.012, ...; a DIFFERENT set at x=2.0, spaced ~pi/x). So 'and at no others' is true of N and FALSE of A. The rung conclusion survives only through a positivity argument that was NOT in the claim: on omega = i kappa the equation is psi'' = (kappa^2 + V)psi with V > 0, so psi_reg is positive and has no zeros there. I asserted about A what I had proved about N. (3) THE ADVERSE CONCLUSION IS STRONGER THAN FILED: at FIXED l the surviving rungs are the whole infinite tower n >= l+1, so there is no single relaxation rate even before summing over multipoles. (4) AND THE FAVOURABLE HALF IS KINEMATIC, NOT GEOMETRIC -- the correction that matters most. EXACT SUM RULE, verified here to 26+ digits at four (x,omega): sum_{l>=0} (2l+1) A_l(x,x;omega) = -omega sinh^2(x). The entire prod(omega^2 + j^2) structure CANCELS IDENTICALLY under the natural (2l+1) degeneracy; the l-summed local spectral density is exactly OHMIC with NO Matsubara-rung zeros at all. The ladder zeros are a PARTIAL-WAVE THRESHOLD FACTOR -- the de Sitter splitting of the flat-space order-(2l+1) centrifugal zero at omega = 0 -- and they survive into the graviton bath SOLELY BECAUSE l = 0 AND l = 1 TENSOR HARMONICS DO NOT EXIST. So the entry above reading 'the geometry genuinely kills the two slowest rungs ... first structural result running the framework's way' IS WITHDRAWN AS TO ITS CAUSE: two missing partial waves kill them and de Sitter does nothing. The effect is real; its cause is a kinematic accident, which is a far weaker thing to book. NO TIER OR LEDGER MOVE. *** *** THE DEFLATION ABOVE OVERSHOT AND HALF OF IT IS RESTORED, 2026-08-19 (owner). 'de Sitter does nothing' concedes more than the panel found. TWO FACTS, NOT ONE. (a) DE SITTER SUPPLIES THE SPLITTING AND THE COINCIDENCE: as H -> 0 the structure omega*prod(omega^2+j^2H^2) collapses to omega^(2l+1) -- the FLAT-SPACE centrifugal threshold zero, one degenerate zero of order 2l+1 at the origin (verified l=1..4). de Sitter splits it into 2l+1 SIMPLE zeros at spacing exactly H, and the Matsubara poles sit at spacing H as well because beta = 2pi/H, SO THE SPLIT LANDS ON THE LADDER. In a flat-space bath at EXTERNAL temperature T the threshold zeros stay bunched at omega = 0 while the poles sit at 2 pi i n T with no relation to the centrifugal structure, so no cancellation is available at any rung ever. That is a genuine de Sitter effect and it is precisely the 'T is not external here' mechanism. (b) THE MISSING l=0 AND l=1 PARTIAL WAVES supply the SURVIVAL into the summed graviton bath after the (2l+1) degeneracy sum -- that half is kinematic accident and its withdrawal stands. THE MECHANISM IS DE SITTER; ITS SURVIVAL IN THE SUMMED BATH IS NOT. AND THE HEADLINE OUTRANKS BOTH AND DEPENDS ON NEITHER: at fixed l the surviving rungs are the entire infinite tower n >= l+1 with lowest rate (l+1)H, multipole-dependent -- cutoff-independent, degeneracy-independent, untouched by the sum rule. This node asserts *the* memory time; the free theory supplies a family indexed by l. SINGLE-POLE IS NOT BADLY DOMINATED HERE -- IT NAMES A SINGLE RATE THAT DOES NOT EXIST AT FREE LEVEL. statements.full_source_line: "tier_note": "POSED 2026-07-02 (Version II, the referee's Frontier 3, adjudicated-in). THE CATCH (conceded): the earlier map said TWO frontiers; there are THREE -- deriving coarse-graining does NOT hand you a constitutive/response structure (that follows only under extra conditions: weak coupling, Gaussianity, near-equilibrium, timescale separation). So three genuinely distinct layers, previously two were collapsed: why-split (U3 / F2, the setup) -> why-constitutive (U4 / F3, the form) -> which-kernel (rung3 / F1, the content). U4 is NOT covered by U1: U1 says 'GIVEN the constitutive conditions, the form is universal-and-standard (Feynman-Vernon)'; U4 asks 'why do those conditions hold at all / why is constitutive structure generic' -- strictly deeper. This is now V2's CENTRAL question (the constitutive-universality question: why do constitutive descriptions appear in every successful EFT?); U1/U2 demote to GRUT-specific INSTANCES of it. It reframes GRUT from a candidate-to-validate into a PROBE of the universality/microscopic boundary -- the boundary where thermodynamics vs statistical mechanics, hydrodynamics vs molecular dynamics, EFT vs UV-completion all live. DISCIPLINE: fenced BOTH directions (do not pre-answer emergent OR forced); do NOT collapse F2 (U3) and F3 (U4); and 'we found a third frontier' is a truer MAP, NOT a third MOVE -- F3 is arguably the LEAST tractable, so forward-gating is unchanged (external: rung3 specialist / dS-IR / foundational-EFT progress). THREE COUPLED FACETS (2026-07-04): U4 is ONE frontier worked in a FIXED ORDER of three coupled facets -- assumption-space (III) -> theorem (VIII) -> interpretation (II); interpretation (II) CANNOT precede the theorem (VIII). One frontier, structured -- fix the assumption-space, prove the theorem, THEN interpret; never interpretation-first. BRANCHES (2026-07-04): U4 is operationalized as a CLASSIFICATION tree under the u0 charter -- u5_constitutive_phases (universality classes of chi) and u6_constitutive_order (order parameter of constitutive organization), each with first-class success AND failure conditions, pointing toward an observable EFT. CENTRAL OBJECT: u4 derives / interrogates the EXISTENCE of 'constitutive organization' (GLOSSARY.md, provisional/revisable per u0) -- the equivalence class of response functionals chi(omega,k) producing identical observable transport under admissible coarse-grainings. See GRUT_II_Agenda.md. RE-HOME POINTER 2026-08-02: the 'is zeta_vacuum = 0?' question from the p_tt interrogation is re-homed to the u5 branch of this tree -- see u5_constitutive_phases.boundary_condition.",

statements.full_source_line: "tier_note": "BANKED 2026-06-27 (consolidated overseer relay, Brief 1 Outcome 3a -- ANCHOR confirmed, NOT refuted): single-pole is ANCHOR-class, derived-pending -- an independent referee found the minimal inputs do NOT determine the transport class (do NOT over-demote this anti-GRUT result past what was shown). TWO-LEVEL FRONTIER (named missing input = the TRANSPORT SELF-ENERGY Sigma controlling G_R = 1/(G0^-1 - Sigma)): (1) committing the system/bath partition yields only the FREE bath correlator (super-Ohmic, collisionless-AT-FREE-LEVEL) which by itself does NOT decide the fork; (2) Sigma additionally needs the bath's INTERNAL dynamics (graviton-graviton scattering / nonlinear mode coupling / Boltzmann) -> read the low-omega scaling CLASS: Ohmic (Im G_R ~ eta*omega) -> single-pole holds; non-Ohmic / Weinberg free-streaming power-law-tail kernel -> single-pole fails. The decision is a one-bit low-omega scaling CLASS read off a FULL transport self-energy calc -- NOT 'one number from one vertex', and NOT the |omega|/sub-Ohmic s<1 shorthand (a RETIRED mischaracterization; the failure mode is the Weinberg branch cut). Do NOT read free-level super-Ohmicity as the Weinberg free-streaming failure branch -- the decision lives entirely in Sigma from the bath's INTERNAL dynamics. So single-pole is pending a MODELING COMMITMENT GRUT has not made, NOT a referee computation; this low-omega scaling class is FRONTIER-RESERVED (specify and hand out, do NOT approximate Sigma in-house). REFEREE REBUTTALS banked as corroboration (no tier/ledger change): KMS != viscosity; de Sitter / Gibbons-Hawking != a colliding gas; Weinberg branch cut = an extra collisionless ASSUMPTION (the collisionless branch, tidied to the Weinberg reading). Bank the PROOF, not the specialist's favorable prior ('the vacuum probably has finite transport coefficients' = ZERO evidential weight; 'finite eta' is strictly weaker than 'single Debye pole'). Collisionality is the ANCHOR's open input #17, decided only by the full transport calc. [Pre-screen history:] GENUINELY OPEN (both leans live), 2026-06-26 -- tier derived-pending with a FAVORABLE-BUT-CIRCULAR lean (see reconciliation at end). [History:] finite-T CONFIRMED 2026-06-25 by open-systems specialist via ANALYTICITY: the coth 1/omega is exactly cancelled by one of the three powers of omega in J~omega^3, so S(omega)=a*omega^2+b*omega^4+... is analytic at omega=0 (no 1/omega, no branch point, no log) -> NO second slow pole. The s:3->2 softening is structural, not numerical; memory stays cutoff-set (tau_c~1/omega_c). Single-pole holds at finite T. Graduated derived-pending -> DERIVED. RE-QUALIFIED 2026-06-26: tier stays 'derived' but REGIME-CONDITIONAL -- the result is real within the COLLISIONAL/ANALYTIC-bath regime; a NEW specialist raised that a COLLISIONLESS free-streaming (Weinberg) bath gives a branch cut that dissolves the single pole (see boundary_condition, second boundary). NOT folded as settled in either direction (three specialists conflict); the deciding question -- is GRUT's bath collisional or free-streaming-collisionless -- is open and traces to the unpinned system/bath split (ledger #2). 'derived, specialist-confirmed' must no longer stand UNQUALIFIED. ISOLATED-BATH VERDICT 2026-06-26 (specialist, FAVORABLE lean -- partial reprieve, NOT settled): the object is rho_chi(omega)=2 Im chi^R_TT(omega) for the vacuum BEFORE the conformalon. Two IR universality classes -- Class A (local vacuum fluctuations: Caldeira-Leggett/DOS/KMS/local Schwinger-Keldysh -> rho~omega^3 analytic, single-pole survives, exponentially-localized memory) vs Class B (free-streaming ballistic transport, Weinberg 2004 -> rho~|omega| or omega^2 ln omega, branch cut, single-pole dissolves, infinite directional memory). LEAN: Class A (rho~omega^3), single-pole SURVIVES -- because GRUT's OWN stated axioms (Gaussian, KMS-locked, linear-response, finite-memory, local influence functional) ARE the analytic class, and nothing in the present formulation introduces a collisionless kinetic sector at the bath level. CAVEAT: 'strong inference, NOT a theorem' -- specialist explicitly declines to settle it. NEAR-CIRCULARITY (mark, do not absorb): GRUT's finite-memory PREMISE essentially IS the Class-A choice, so single-pole 'following' is partly definitional; the genuinely independent earned content is the finite-T analyticity robustness check (within Class A, finite-T could have generated a slow second pole and does not). THE REAL OPEN QUESTION (sharpened by the specialist): NOT the exponent but 'what is the bath HILBERT SPACE integrated out to produce the GRUT influence functional?' -- needs a FIRST-PRINCIPLES derivation of rho_chi from the microscopic DOF, not argument-by-analogy to either oscillator baths or collisionless transport. Tier STAYS derived-pending (favorable lean, not settled). Net ledger unchanged (+10); collisionality input #17 refined to 'GRUT's vacuum is Class A (the bath Hilbert space is Gaussian KMS fluctuations, not free-streaming carriers)'. TRANSPORT/VISCOSITY PIN 2026-06-26 (REVERSES the above lean, lands AGAINST single-pole, demotes derived-pending -> ASSUMED): the previous chain (and the original DOS argument) committed a CATEGORY ERROR -- the super-Ohmic omega^3/omega^4 object is the T=0 VACUUM RESPONSE (graviton-emission phase space, high-freq probe), NOT the thermal MEMORY kernel. The right variable is NOT an exponent but tau_collision: single-pole memory time = the collision time, single-pole <=> tau_collision << tau_0. KEY FACT (rock-solid kinetic theory, not a delicate loop): a FREE field has INFINITE shear viscosity (nothing relaxes momentum, eta ~ tau_collision -> inf); the transport peak narrows to a delta(omega) of diverging weight (non-decaying shear mode) = the non-analytic structure, tau_K -> inf. The MINIMAL de Sitter vacuum is FREE fields -> tau_collision = inf -> FREE-STREAMING -> single-pole DISSOLVES (NOT super-Ohmic omega^3). de Sitter adds T_dS=H/2pi but NO collisions unless put in by hand; the only escape is super-horizon FREEZING (omega<H modes don't free-stream, may suppress the delta(omega) weight) -- but that is (a) UNCOMPUTED and (b) even maximally gives tau_K ~ 1/H ~ 14 Gyr ~ 300x tau_0 (~42 Myr) [MARKER 2026-08-18, not a correction: '~42 Myr' is the PRIOR LINEAGE's figure, appearing here only comparatively, inside the argument RETRACTED the same day by its own proposer (see the RECONCILED entry). It is not banked, and no node's content depends on a value of the memory scale -- confirmed by the 2026-08-18 sweep of all 18 nodes touching it, which found only limits, class questions, and the separately-priced second scale. Retained because the retracted reasoning is retained; marked so a reader grepping the clean register for a memory-scale value cannot misread it as banked.] = the SLOW regime, STILL not single-pole. So single-pole requires GRUT to POSIT collisions with tau_collision << tau_0 -- a NEW microphysical input the minimal vacuum does NOT supply. Hence ASSUMED (+1), not derived. RIGOROUS COMPUTATION (the de-anchor, for the Part-1 specialist, in isolation before the conformalon): Im<T_TT T_TT>(omega->0,k->0) for a free field on de Sitter in Bunch-Davies/Gibbons-Hawking, into the super-horizon limit, with free-streaming-vs-freezing as the explicit object. RECONCILED 2026-06-26 (proposer of the transport pin UPDATES -- this is the settled state): the viscosity argument is FLAT-SPACE finite-T kinetic and does NOT cleanly transfer to de Sitter -- Gibbons-Hawking is observer-dependent (not a real particle gas), the Bunch-Davies vacuum stress correlator is ANALYTIC by microcausality, and super-horizon FREEZING can suppress exactly the streaming piece the argument leans on. So Class B is NOT established on dS and Class A (analytic) has real merit there. STATE: GENUINELY OPEN, both leans live (NOT 'leans against', NOT split-the-difference). Tier reverts ASSUMED -> DERIVED-PENDING; ledger +1 -> 0; net +11 -> +10. SHARPENED CIRCULARITY (tighter than 'axioms favor A'): Gaussian/KMS/linear-response do NOT force Class A -- a Gaussian KMS bath can free-stream (Weinberg's neutrinos ARE essentially that). The axiom that forces Class A is LOCALITY/FINITE-MEMORY of the influence functional == single-pole RESTATED. So the favorable lean and the assumption are the SAME object -> the lean carries ALMOST NO independent evidential weight; do NOT bank it as reassurance. The ONLY genuinely-independent earned content is the small finite-T robustness check (within the assumed analytic class, coth could have manufactured a slow second pole and does not -- real, small, the right size). CONVERGENCE = the actual signal: specialist (lean A) + proposer (lean B) + the document (ledger #2 system/bath split) all land on the BATH HILBERT SPACE -- three paths, one question, robust BECAUSE it survives the disagreement about which way single-pole goes. *** ADVERSE EVIDENCE RECORDED RETROSPECTIVELY, 2026-08-19 (owner ruling: evidence moved and nothing fired, so it is recorded in the node's own text rather than by superseding a pre-registration; NO TIER OR LEDGER MOVE). calc/finite_T_pole_structure.py answers the question calc/finite_T_exponent.py left open on 2026-06-25 -- 'does the s_eff=2 spectrum carry a slow second pole that the cutoff-set memory time hides?' It is not a second pole. coth(omega/2T) has a simple pole at omega = 2 pi i n T for EVERY n, residue 2T; this is a property of the KMS factor alone and is independent of J and of the regulator. With T = H/2pi -- fixed uniquely here at rung2 and paid at rung5, explicitly not a free input -- the NOISE kernel carries a MATSUBARA LADDER at omega = -i n H, spacing exactly H. Weighting by residue (J ~ omega^3 gives n^3), the leading rung's share is (1-x)^4/(1+4x+x^2) with x = e^{-Ht}: 6.1% at Ht = 1, reaching 90% only at Ht = 4.32. rung7 carries tau_2 ~ 1/H0, i.e. Ht ~ 1, so THE COSMOLOGICAL SECTOR OPERATES ABOUT FOUR E-FOLDS SHORT OF WHERE SINGLE-POLE BECOMES A GOOD APPROXIMATION, and no limit of the parameters moves it there because H is the only scale the framework has. Robust to the regulator: truncating at n <= 3 lifts the Ht = 1 share only to 13.2%. AND IT IS DENSER THAN THE STRUCTURE IT REPLACED -- the static-patch QNM tower retracted the same day had spacing 2H; this ladder has spacing H, and the second rung is ~294% of the first at Ht = 1 once residues are included. 'The tower was retracted' reads as a reprieve and is the opposite. THE ONE STEP NOT TAKEN, which is this node's actual claim: the ladder is in the NOISE kernel of the bilinear QBM split; the retarded kernel is T-independent and untouched. Whether the Mori-Zwanzig memory kernel of the projected dynamics INHERITS the ladder is not established. It is sharply posed rather than open-ended: KMS ties N to Im K_R, so N inherits coth's poles UNLESS Im K_R has zeros at the Matsubara frequencies that cancel them, and that cancellation is the only route by which the projected kernel could fail to inherit the ladder. *** *** THE ADVERSE FILING ABOVE IS NARROWED, 2026-08-19, BY THE PARTY IT DISFAVOURS. calc/mz_inheritance.py takes the inheritance step. TWO RESULTS, opposite in direction. (1) THE ESCAPE ROUTE IS CLOSED: the framework's own J has no zeros on the imaginary axis (J(i v) = eta (i v)^3 exp(+v^2/w_c^2), nonzero for every v and every s tested), so nothing cancels coth's poles and the SYMMETRISED noise kernel does inherit the ladder exactly as framed. (2) BUT THE SYMMETRISED CORRELATION IS NOT THE ONLY CANDIDATE, AND THE OTHER STANDARD ONE HAS NO LADDER. Mori-Zwanzig projection for a quantum system conventionally uses the KUBO-MORI (canonical) inner product, and the Kubo correlation carries C_K(w) = 2 chi''(w)/(beta w) rather than C_S(w) = chi''(w) coth(beta w/2) -- derived here from the Kubo transform's definition, not quoted. The coth is REPLACED by 2/(beta w): every Matsubara pole is gone, leaving one pole at w = 0. Separately, the generalised-Langevin FRICTION kernel contains no temperature at all (verified bit-identical at two temperatures) while the noise kernel's late-time rate tracks 2 pi T to 0.07-0.09%. SO: the phrase 'the Mori-Zwanzig kernel' in this node's own statement DOES NOT DENOTE A UNIQUE OBJECT, and the two objects it could denote answer the inheritance question OPPOSITELY. The adverse reading is therefore CONDITIONAL on identifying it with the symmetrised correlation, which this node does not do. This is a defect in the node's STATEMENT, not in its physics; it is cheap to repair and must be repaired before the ladder can be said to bear on the conjecture. Until then the ladder neither refutes nor spares single-pole, and the honest disposition is that the node is UNDER-SPECIFIED exactly where the evidence would bite. *** *** AND A SCOPE CORRECTION TO THE STATIC-PATCH WORK, same date, also against the adverse direction (owner): A POLE-FREE FREE RESPONSE IS NULL, NOT ADVERSE. Pure de Sitter has no scattering centre; the graviton potential is purely centrifugal, l(l+1)/sinh^2(H r_*), and that exactly-solvable case is FORCED to return a finite Blaschke amplitude. A trivial scattering problem returns a trivial answer, so the free level carries no evidence either way -- and with c = 0 now DERIVED (calc/static_patch_tt_response.py PART 1b), the 'artefact of an exactly-solvable potential' caveat is the operative fact rather than a hedge. Everything that bears on this node rests on the interacting self-energy Sigma. *** *** AND THE NARROWING IS ITSELF NARROWED, 2026-08-19, BACK TOWARD ADVERSE -- because reading THIS NODE'S OWN PRE-EXISTING TEXT answers the convention question it was said to leave open. This node has carried since 2026-06-25: 'finite-T CONFIRMED ... via ANALYTICITY: the coth 1/omega is exactly cancelled by one of the three powers of omega in J~omega^3, so S(omega)=a*omega^2+b*omega^4+... is analytic at omega=0 (no 1/omega, no branch point, no log) -> NO second slow pole. ... memory stays cutoff-set (tau_c~1/omega_c). Single-pole holds at finite T.' TWO CONSEQUENCES. (i) THE CONVENTION IS NOT UNSTATED AFTER ALL: that check is performed on S = J coth, the SYMMETRISED noise spectrum, so this node's own finite-T history identifies its kernel and the adverse reading of the Matsubara ladder APPLIES rather than being conditional. The narrowing recorded above was too generous to this node and is withdrawn to that extent. (ii) THE BANKED CLAIM'S NEGATIVE HALF DOES NOT FOLLOW FROM ITS ARGUMENT. The positive half is correct and is re-verified in calc/mz_inheritance.py PART 3b: with J ~ omega^3 the 1/omega really is cancelled and S is analytic at the origin. But 'analytic at omega = 0' is a statement about ONE POINT, and coth's poles sit at omega = 2 pi i n/beta for every n != 0, where J does not vanish -- residue J(2 pi i n/beta)*(2/beta), verified nonzero at n = 1,2,3,7. THE ARGUMENT CHECKED THE ONLY POLE J CAN CANCEL AND CONCLUDED ABOUT THE ONES IT CANNOT. Correspondingly 'memory stays cutoff-set' is false: the ladder's slowest component sits at 1/(2 pi T) = 1/H, which for this framework is enormously slower than any UV cutoff time. TWO INSTRUMENTS, TWO DIFFERENT MISSES, ONE BANKED CONCLUSION: the analyticity check looked at the single point where cancellation was possible, and the tau_nu memory-time diagnostic is a |nu|-weighted mean in which the ladder carries almost none of the weight (calc/finite_T_pole_structure.py PART 4). 'Single-pole holds at finite T' rests on both. NO TIER OR LEDGER MOVE is taken here; this is the same retrospective recording the owner ruled for, and what it changes is that the ladder's adverse bearing is now unconditional rather than convention-dependent. *** *** MULTIPOLE CORRECTION AND A TWO-SIDED RESULT, 2026-08-19, calc/mz_inheritance.py PART 1b. THE CORRECTION IS FILED FIRST BECAUSE THE FAVOURABLE HALF IS THE QUOTABLE ONE. The graviton has NO l = 0 and NO l = 1, so every physical multipole has l >= 2; an earlier pass tabulated l = 1, which is not a graviton mode. The free static-patch spectral function A_l vanishes at the first l Matsubara rungs, so THE SLOWEST SURVIVING RUNG IS (l+1)H. CONSEQUENCE, AGAINST THE ENTRIES ABOVE: the free-level memory time is 1/(3H), NOT 1/H, and every statement in this register reading 'slowest rung exactly H' or 'memory time 1/H' -- including the Matsubara-ladder filing earlier this same day -- is about a ladder containing modes the graviton does not have. AND IT IS MULTIPOLE-DEPENDENT: 3H at l=2, 4H at l=3, (l+1)H generally. THIS NODE ASSERTS *THE* MEMORY TIME; THE FREE THEORY SUPPLIES A FAMILY INDEXED BY MULTIPOLE. That is a stronger objection than any share arithmetic: single-pole is not a poorly-dominated approximation here, the single rate it approximates DOES NOT EXIST at free level. THE FAVOURABLE HALF, real and booked as such: because every physical l >= 2, RUNGS n = 1 AND n = 2 VANISH FOR EVERY PHYSICAL MULTIPOLE -- the geometry genuinely kills the two slowest rungs, the ones governing late-time memory. That is the first structural result in this fortnight running toward the framework. It does not rescue single-pole: the leading surviving rung carries 6.4% at l=2 and Ht=1 (2.5% at l=3, 1.0% at l=4 -- the share FALLS with l), and the escape still requires Sigma to manufacture zeros at n > l where the free theory has none, l-dependently, to yield any single rate at all. STATUS: numerically verified, NOT adversarially tested, and it runs the direction the builder already expected -- the profile of both errors this week. Not to carry a dispatch until a hostile pass has had it. NO TIER OR LEDGER MOVE. *** *** ADVERSARIAL PASS, 2026-08-19: all four lenses returned NOT-REFUTED -- the adverse conclusion stands -- and all four found the STATEMENT wrong. calc/mz_inheritance.py PART 1c. (1) THE ZERO SET WAS UNDER-COUNTED, FAVOURABLY: N carries an overall factor of omega, so it vanishes at omega = 0 and at the negative rungs too -- exactly 2l+1 zeros, |n| <= l -- so l+1 NON-NEGATIVE rungs cancel, not l. (2) 'A IS PROPORTIONAL TO N' IS FALSE AS WRITTEN, reported independently by two lenses: A = N psi_reg(x_<) psi_reg(x_>)/(2iW), and that prefactor is entire of order 1 with INFINITELY MANY zeros (for l=2 at x=0.9 near omega = 6.256, 10.012, ...; a DIFFERENT set at x=2.0, spaced ~pi/x). So 'and at no others' is true of N and FALSE of A. The rung conclusion survives only through a positivity argument that was NOT in the claim: on omega = i kappa the equation is psi'' = (kappa^2 + V)psi with V > 0, so psi_reg is positive and has no zeros there. I asserted about A what I had proved about N. (3) THE ADVERSE CONCLUSION IS STRONGER THAN FILED: at FIXED l the surviving rungs are the whole infinite tower n >= l+1, so there is no single relaxation rate even before summing over multipoles. (4) AND THE FAVOURABLE HALF IS KINEMATIC, NOT GEOMETRIC -- the correction that matters most. EXACT SUM RULE, verified here to 26+ digits at four (x,omega): sum_{l>=0} (2l+1) A_l(x,x;omega) = -omega sinh^2(x). The entire prod(omega^2 + j^2) structure CANCELS IDENTICALLY under the natural (2l+1) degeneracy; the l-summed local spectral density is exactly OHMIC with NO Matsubara-rung zeros at all. The ladder zeros are a PARTIAL-WAVE THRESHOLD FACTOR -- the de Sitter splitting of the flat-space order-(2l+1) centrifugal zero at omega = 0 -- and they survive into the graviton bath SOLELY BECAUSE l = 0 AND l = 1 TENSOR HARMONICS DO NOT EXIST. So the entry above reading 'the geometry genuinely kills the two slowest rungs ... first structural result running the framework's way' IS WITHDRAWN AS TO ITS CAUSE: two missing partial waves kill them and de Sitter does nothing. The effect is real; its cause is a kinematic accident, which is a far weaker thing to book. NO TIER OR LEDGER MOVE. *** *** THE DEFLATION ABOVE OVERSHOT AND HALF OF IT IS RESTORED, 2026-08-19 (owner). 'de Sitter does nothing' concedes more than the panel found. TWO FACTS, NOT ONE. (a) DE SITTER SUPPLIES THE SPLITTING AND THE COINCIDENCE: as H -> 0 the structure omega*prod(omega^2+j^2H^2) collapses to omega^(2l+1) -- the FLAT-SPACE centrifugal threshold zero, one degenerate zero of order 2l+1 at the origin (verified l=1..4). de Sitter splits it into 2l+1 SIMPLE zeros at spacing exactly H, and the Matsubara poles sit at spacing H as well because beta = 2pi/H, SO THE SPLIT LANDS ON THE LADDER. In a flat-space bath at EXTERNAL temperature T the threshold zeros stay bunched at omega = 0 while the poles sit at 2 pi i n T with no relation to the centrifugal structure, so no cancellation is available at any rung ever. That is a genuine de Sitter effect and it is precisely the 'T is not external here' mechanism. (b) THE MISSING l=0 AND l=1 PARTIAL WAVES supply the SURVIVAL into the summed graviton bath after the (2l+1) degeneracy sum -- that half is kinematic accident and its withdrawal stands. THE MECHANISM IS DE SITTER; ITS SURVIVAL IN THE SUMMED BATH IS NOT. AND THE HEADLINE OUTRANKS BOTH AND DEPENDS ON NEITHER: at fixed l the surviving rungs are the entire infinite tower n >= l+1 with lowest rate (l+1)H, multipole-dependent -- cutoff-independent, degeneracy-independent, untouched by the sum rule. This node asserts *the* memory time; the free theory supplies a family indexed by l. SINGLE-POLE IS NOT BADLY DOMINATED HERE -- IT NAMES A SINGLE RATE THAT DOES NOT EXIST AT FREE LEVEL. NO TIER OR LEDGER MOVE. ***",

statements.full_source_line: "boundary_condition": "CONDITIONAL (logged as a known boundary, not absorbed): the confirmation holds for the standard QBM construction with a smooth UV cutoff + bilinear coupling, PROVIDED GRUT's vacuum bath carries NO second internal dynamical scale (resonance/diffusive mode). A second scale would give a genuine second pole tau_2 (nu(t)~A e^{-t/tau_c}+B e^{-t/tau_2}). See rung7: an evolving w(z) REQUIRES exactly such a second (cosmologically slow) scale -- the two facts are coupled. SECOND BOUNDARY (2026-06-26, NEW specialist, NOT folded as settled): single-pole holds for a COLLISIONAL / analytic-noise bath. For a genuinely COLLISIONLESS free-streaming bath (Weinberg 2004 nonlocal memory) the kernel is power-law (K(t)~1/t^alpha, Bessel tails) -> Sigma(omega) has a BRANCH CUT at omega->0 (~|omega| or omega^2 log omega), NOT a pole -> the single pole DISSOLVES into a continuum (no dynamical mass, power-law not exponential relaxation). THREE specialists now CONFLICT on single-pole: (1) DOS [3+1D free relativistic modes super-Ohmic, J~omega^3 analytic -> holds], (2) analyticity [finite-T coth cancellation -> holds], (3) Weinberg [collisionless free-streaming -> branch cut -> FAILS]. Likely reconciliation = two senses of 'collisionless': the DOS/SPECTRUM of vacuum fluctuations (single-pole survives) vs FREE-STREAMING TRANSPORT of anisotropic stress (branch cut). Which GRUT's bath instantiates is decided by the UNPINNED system/bath split (ledger #2). So single-pole is DERIVED WITHIN THE COLLISIONAL/ANALYTIC REGIME; whether GRUT's vacuum is in that regime is OPEN -- the next question, to specialist 1 (does the DOS/analytic single-pole survive a Weinberg free-streaming bath, or does it introduce a branch cut the analysis omitted?). SPINE TEST RUN 2026-07-04 (loaded onto the Tan-Tsamis-Woodard COMPUTED object, arXiv:2103.08547 -- an EXTRACTION of the low-omega transport class from a known pure-graviton dS self-energy, NOT a from-scratch loop; four grapples both-directions vs the firewall guards; DEFAULT-BROKEN). VERDICT: UNDER-DETERMINED -- but EARNED, replacing the previously-guessed 'probably under-determined' (predicting the outcome was exactly the move the discipline forbids). The probe does NOT graduate rung3 (STAYS derived-pending, ledger 0): the low-omega TT class lives in the gauge/scheme/prescription-dependent part of the object -- the 30-year dS-IR controversy in local form (the gauge-artifact, scheme-flip, and null-collision guards all fire). It banked THREE grounded things the guess did not have. (1) TT-FROZEN [leading-order, simplest-gauge; does NOT clear the gauge guard]: the perturbative TT sector does NOT itself provide evidence for the branch-cut (Class-B) interpretation -- TTW state explicitly 'there are no changes in the graviton mode function' at one loop, and the secular ln(a) is in the SPIN-0 potentials Psi, Phi, NOT the TT channel that G_R^TT probes. This DEFUSES the REFUTED reading FOR THE TT CHANNEL, and is NOT evidence for single-pole: a frozen mode function is EQUALLY consistent with a trivial / no-response -- the Higuchi/Marolf-Morrison stability horn. So 'frozen' sits BETWEEN single-pole and trivial and distinguishes NEITHER (absence-of-evidence-against, not evidence-for). CRISP FORM [external specialist wording, adopted verbatim 2026-07-04, cleaner than the in-house phrasing]: 'The existing perturbative TT calculations remove one commonly cited argument for an inevitable branch-cut interpretation, but they do not positively establish a relaxation pole.' So three genuinely distinct layers, previously two were collapsed: why-split (U3 / F2, the setup) -> why-constitutive (U4 / F3, the form) -> which-kernel (rung3 / F1, the content). U4 is NOT covered by U1: U1 says 'GIVEN the constitutive conditions, the form is universal-and-standard (Feynman-Vernon)'; U4 asks 'why do those conditions hold at all / why is constitutive structure generic' -- strictly deeper. This is now V2's CENTRAL question (the constitutive-universality question: why do constitutive descriptions appear in every successful EFT?); U1/U2 demote to GRUT-specific INSTANCES of it. It reframes GRUT from a candidate-to-validate into a PROBE of the universality/microscopic boundary -- the boundary where thermodynamics vs statistical mechanics, hydrodynamics vs molecular dynamics, EFT vs UV-completion all live. DISCIPLINE: fenced BOTH directions (do not pre-answer emergent OR forced); do NOT collapse F2 (U3) and F3 (U4); and 'we found a third frontier' is a truer MAP, NOT a third MOVE -- F3 is arguably the LEAST tractable, so forward-gating is unchanged (external: rung3 specialist / dS-IR / foundational-EFT progress). THREE COUPLED FACETS (2026-07-04): U4 is ONE frontier worked in a FIXED ORDER of three coupled facets -- assumption-space (III) -> theorem (VIII) -> interpretation (II); interpretation (II) CANNOT precede the theorem (VIII). One frontier, structured -- fix the assumption-space, prove the theorem, THEN interpret; never interpretation-first.
